comment: OrangeHRM's public demo login, driven by Jev end to end (hrm-add-employee scripts the same login in setup). The credentials are the ones the login page prints (Admin / admin123); the password is still listed in secrets to exercise masking on a value Jev types. A slow single-page app: the login page is an empty shell until the app renders (setup waits for the Username field, otherwise step 1 has nothing to act on), and a spinner covers the page after Login before the Dashboard route appears, hence settle_ms 2500 and a 45 s navigation timeout. text_in on the topbar breadcrumb because the sidebar and widgets also mention 'Dashboard'.
goal: Log in with the given username and password so that the Dashboard opens: the topbar heading says 'Dashboard' and the left sidebar lists the modules (Admin, PIM, Leave, Time).
notes: The login page has a Username field, a Password field and a Login button; it also prints the demo credentials as text, which is not a control. After Login a loading spinner shows for a moment before the Dashboard appears: wait for it. Do not click 'Forgot your password?'.

checks.on_login_page: The page heading says 'Login' and Username and Password fields are shown
checks.loading: A loading spinner is shown and no page heading yet

dashboard_shown.when: The topbar heading says 'Dashboard'. The left sidebar lists PIM among the modules

login_rejected.when: A red 'Invalid credentials' message is shown above the login form
login_rejected.note: the credentials are the ones the page itself prints

required_error.when: A red 'Required' message is shown under the Username or the Password field
required_error.note: both values were provided in data: a field was left empty or the form lost the typed value

app_error.when: An error page, a stack trace or 'something went wrong' text is shown
